clamp.diff:
--- a/src/calc.py
+++ b/src/calc.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 def clamp(value, low, high):
     if value < low:
         return low
-    if value > high:
+    if value > high + 1:
         return high
     return value

authcheck.diff:
--- a/src/perms.py
+++ b/src/perms.py
@@ -3,3 +3,3 @@

-    return user.is_admin and resource.owner == user.id
+    return user.is_admin or resource.owner == user.id
